v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Caríssimi: Omne, quod natum est ex Deo, vincit mundum: et hæc est victória, quæ vincit mundum, fides nostra.
text.en: My beloved: For whatsoever is born of God, overcometh the world: and this is the victory which overcometh the world, our faith.

v.en: Stay with us, O Lord, alleluia.

r.en: Because it is towards evening, alleluia.

text.la: Post dies octo * iánuis clausis ingréssus Dóminus dixit eis: Pax vobis, allelúia, allelúia.
text.en: After eight days * came the Lord, the doors being shut, and said unto them: Peace be unto you, alleluia, alleluia.

text.la: Præsta, quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus: ut qui paschália festa perégimus, hæc, te largiénte, móribus et vita teneámus.
text.en: Grant, we beseech Thee, almighty God, that we who have celebrated the Paschal Feast, may, by Thy bounty, retain its fruits in our daily habits and behaviour.

title.en: Annunciation of the Blessed Virgin Mary

text.la: Spíritus Sanctus in te descéndet, María, et virtus Altíssimi obumbrábit tibi. Allelúia.
text.en: The Holy Ghost shall come upon thee, O Mary, and the power of the Highest shall overshadow thee. Alleluia.

v.en: Hail, Mary, full of grace. Alleluia.

r.en: The Lord is with thee. Alleluia.

text.la: Deus, qui de beátæ Maríæ Vírginis útero Verbum tuum, Angelo nuntiánte, carnem suscípere voluísti: præsta supplícibus tuis; ut, qui vere eam Genetrícem Dei crédimus, eius apud te intercessiónibus adiuvémur.
text.en: O God, Who didst will that thy Word should, by the message of an Angel, take flesh in the womb of the Blessed Virgin Mary, grant unto us, we beseech thee, that all who do believe her to be in very deed the Mother of God, may be helped by her prayers in thy sight.

office.title: Dominica in Albis in Octava Paschæ
